title: Data & Analytics
label: Business Data Infrastructure
audience: Teams working across spreadsheets, reports and disconnected data
summary: Bring reporting into one reliable view, from cleaner source files to KPI dashboards that explain what is happening.
symptoms: Monthly reports take too long to prepare
Different teams use conflicting versions of the same metric
Decisions depend on manually combining spreadsheets
includes: Data-source review and KPI definition
Cleaning and validation rules for spreadsheets or SQL data
Management reporting dashboards and control workbooks
Documentation and handover for ongoing reporting
steps: Discover
Review your reports, sources, definitions and decision needs.
Design & build
Prepare a model, checks and decision-focused reports.
Hand over
Validate with stakeholders, document the logic and agree refresh ownership.
tools: Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python and Power BI, selected to fit the scope

evidence.title: Analytics demonstration
evidence.description: Our homepage includes a labelled illustrative dashboard. Figures are synthetic rather than client performance results.

faqs: Can you work with my existing spreadsheets?
Yes. We start by assessing your current files and agreeing which fields and metrics need to be trustworthy.
Will the dashboard update automatically?
That depends on the sources, access and budget. Refresh and automation are defined during scoping.
Who owns the outputs?
Ownership, access and handover arrangements are agreed in writing before a project begins.

title: Workflow Automation
label: Automation & Digital Operations
audience: Operations teams repeating the same administrative work
summary: Connect forms, spreadsheets, reporting and notifications so routine steps require less manual attention.
symptoms: The same details are copied between tools
Requests get lost between inboxes and spreadsheets
Recurring reports require manual reminders and exports
includes: Workflow mapping and control-point review
Google Sheets and Apps Script automations where appropriate
Notifications, validation and approval checkpoints
Test cases, failure handling and operating notes
steps: Map
Identify each trigger, handoff, owner and exception.
Pilot
Build one manageable flow and test sample and failure cases.
Operate
Document ownership, monitoring and recovery steps.
tools: Google Apps Script, Python, spreadsheets, APIs and suitable workflow integrations

evidence.title: Operational tracker work
evidence.description: Experience with recurring KPI reporting and master trackers informs the approach. No unverified time savings are claimed.

faqs: Do I need to change all my tools?
Usually not. We evaluate your current tools first and suggest integration before replacement.
What happens when an automation fails?
The specification includes alerting, a human fallback and ownership where the integration supports it.
Will you automate sensitive decisions?
High-impact workflows need explicit approvals, access controls and human review before deployment.

title: Web & Online Presence
label: Web and Digital Presence
audience: Founders, businesses and creators who need a credible online home
summary: Build a clear, accessible website that explains what you offer and makes the next step easy for visitors.
symptoms: Visitors cannot quickly understand your offer
An outdated site does not reflect your work
Contact, payments or analytics are disconnected
includes: Site structure, messaging and responsive design
Landing pages, business websites or scoped commerce flows
Contact flows and basic measurement planning
Launch QA, documentation and handover
steps: Plan
Agree content, pages, platform and key visitor journeys.
Create
Build responsive pages, integrate agreed services and test the experience.
Launch
Review accessibility, tracking, security settings and handover.
tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and project-appropriate hosting or commerce platforms

evidence.title: SonofIAM website
evidence.description: The SonofIAM digital experience is a delivered web project. We do not attribute unmeasured revenue or conversion improvements to it.

faqs: Can you work on an existing website?
Yes. We can review an existing site and define a focused improvement scope.
Do you provide ongoing hosting?
Hosting, account ownership and maintenance are agreed as separate line items if requested.
Will I be able to update my own content?
We discuss content editing and handover needs before choosing the website architecture.

title: Commerce & Conversion
label: Commerce and Conversion
audience: Stores and service businesses with fragmented enquiry or checkout journeys
summary: Map the steps from a visitor’s interest to a completed enquiry or purchase, then improve the weakest handoffs.
symptoms: Customers encounter confusing checkout steps
Orders and stock updates need repetitive reconciliation
Traffic cannot be tied to completed enquiries or sales
includes: Conversion journey review and basic event plan
Scoped checkout, forms or product-page improvements
Order-tracking and operational handoff design
A measurement and validation checklist
steps: Audit
Map the current journey, integrations and failure points.
Prioritise
Agree realistic changes and the metrics that could validate them.
Pilot
Implement a small release and verify it before expanding.
tools: Analytics, spreadsheets and selected ecommerce or payment integrations

evidence.title: SonofIAM digital storefront experience
evidence.description: Our web project includes digital-commerce foundations; verified conversion outcomes are not yet published.

faqs: Can you guarantee a conversion lift?
No. We can recommend and test improvements, but results depend on traffic, audience and implementation.
Do you handle customer payment details?
Any payment work should use appropriate hosted provider flows. We do not request raw card details.
What is a sensible first milestone?
A checkout or enquiry-journey audit with agreed high-priority fixes.

title: SEO & AI Visibility
label: SEO and AI Visibility
audience: Teams that want people to find accurate information about their business
summary: Create a technically clear site and useful service content that search engines and people can understand.
symptoms: Important pages are difficult to discover
Search results show outdated descriptions
Content is inconsistent across key pages
includes: Technical site and content structure review
Page titles, metadata and internal linking
Sitemap, indexability and basic structured-content plan
Search measurement setup recommendations
steps: Inspect
Check public pages, crawl signals and service messaging.
Improve
Prioritise on-page content, metadata and navigation.
Measure
Agree a baseline and monitor changes without promising rankings.
tools: Search Console, web analytics and standard web SEO tooling where client access permits

evidence.title: Marvelous Ascent website work
evidence.description: This site shows our own metadata, navigation and service-structure approach. It does not establish client search-ranking results.

faqs: Can you guarantee first-page rankings?
No. Search results are controlled by search engines and competition changes.
Do you create content?
Content outlines and selected copywriting can be included in a separately agreed scope.
What about AI search results?
We focus on accurate, accessible, well-structured public information rather than promises of inclusion.

title: Advertising & Campaign Optimisation
label: Paid Advertising
audience: Teams ready to measure campaign outcomes instead of relying on reach alone
summary: Plan campaigns around a measurable business objective, a clear budget and reliable conversion tracking.
symptoms: Spend is reported without business outcomes
Campaign links and attribution are inconsistent
There is no repeatable campaign review process
includes: Campaign measurement and tagging plan
KPI definitions, reporting template and review cadence
Creative and audience-testing hypotheses
Budget and account-control recommendations
steps: Define
Choose business goals, authorised access and baseline measurements.
Prepare
Set tracking and a test plan with clear spending limits.
Review
Evaluate results and document what should change next.
tools: Campaign-platform reports, analytics and spreadsheets, subject to platform access

evidence.title: Enquiry-led service
evidence.description: Campaign management is not presented here as a proven retainer service. We scope measurement or a pilot before making delivery commitments.

faqs: Do you promise a return on ad spend?
No. Any assumptions, budgets and success measures must be agreed before testing.
Who pays the advertising budget?
Ad spend remains separate from any agency fee and should stay under client-controlled accounts.
Do you run long-term social management?
No ongoing social-community management is included unless a specific separate engagement is agreed.

title: Market Research & Surveys
label: Market Research and Surveys
audience: Businesses needing evidence before pricing, product or market decisions
summary: Turn market questions into a defined research brief, traceable sources and decision-ready findings.
symptoms: Pricing decisions are based on assumptions
Competitor information is scattered or unverified
Survey responses are collected but not analysed
includes: Research question, sampling and source plan
Market and competitor desk research
Survey design and basic data quality checks
Findings report with methods, limitations and recommendations
steps: Frame
Agree the commercial question and evidence boundaries.
Collect
Document sources, dates, definitions and checks.
Report
Present patterns, uncertainties and practical next decisions.
tools: Web research, spreadsheets, Python and survey tools as relevant

evidence.title: Art-market pricing research
evidence.description: Art-market pricing analysis provides an example of a research workflow; sources and findings are not published as a client outcome here.

faqs: Can you research international markets?
Yes, if the requested market, timeframe and available data can be scoped responsibly.
Will you build and analyse surveys?
We can design a survey and analyse its responses, subject to consent and sample-quality limitations.
How will I know the data is reliable?
Reports should identify sources, assumptions, missing data and what cannot be concluded.
